operations.details: Verified current Ordnance Survey OS Net positioning service.
Active continuously operating OS Net separated from legacy passive control.
Centimetre-level positioning capability not promoted to unconditional parcel-height accuracy.
RINEX/real-time positioning requires observation and processing provenance.
Verified Ordnance Survey legacy control data scope.
Passive stations, benchmarks and triangulation archive marked no longer maintained.
Current OS Net and modern transformation stack retained as authoritative positioning framework.
Legacy control retained as historical context only.
GNSS capability kept separate from LiDAR raster and sampling uncertainty.
No GNSS capability or archive-control value substituted for parcel elevation.
Canonical manifest unchanged; serial publisher still required.
